questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'. **

Saying this, she (1)/ storm out of the room, (2)/ leaving her bags behind. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Reading this sentence we understand that the above-mentioned sentence talked about past activities that completed at a particular time.
 
• Thus we use **stormed ou**t__ instead of** storm out.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** **

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

We recommend that (1)/ you keep your (2)/ advice to yourself. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option (4)** i.e. **"No error".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Two clauses are connected by 'that'.
 
• "We recommend" here 'We' is the plural subject and 'recommend' is the plural verb. It is in the simple present tense.
 
• "you keep your advice to yourself" Here the subject is 'you'. 'keep' is the verb. It is also in the simple present tense.
 
• 'your' is used here as a possessive adjective. 'advice' is used here as a noun. 'yourself' is the reflexive pronoun.
 
• All the parts of speech and verbs are used correctly.
 
• Hence the sentence is grammatically and contextually correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is "No error".** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****'Advise'** is a verb.** 'Advice'** is an uncountable noun.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.** 

Primitive
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e.** 'Basic'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Primitive: (आदिम)** - Being the first or earliest of the kind or existing in a simple or basic form.

 
 
• **Example:** The tribe lived in a primitive society with no written language.
 
 
 
• **Basic: (मूल)** - Forming an essential foundation or starting point; fundamental.
 
 
• **Example:** Understanding basic math is essential for advanced studies.
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that Basic is similar to Primitive in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Basic'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Present: (वर्तमान)** - Existing or happening now.

 
 
• **Example:** In the present era, technology plays a vital role in our lives.
 
 
 
• **New: (नया)** - Not existing before; made, introduced, or discovered recently or now for the first time.
 
 
• **Example:** They moved to a new city for better opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Modern: (आधुनिक)** - Relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past.
 
 
• **Example:** He prefers modern architecture over traditional styles.

questions.solution:

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in meaning of the given word.** 

Virtual
questions.solution:

__
 
• The word **"Virtual"** means something that is almost or nearly as described, but not completely or according to strict definition. (वास्तविकता में नहीं)
 
 
• **Example:** In the virtual world of online gaming, players can become anyone they want to be.
 
 
 
• **"Authentic"** refers to something that is genuine and real, not false or copied; it is the opposite of virtual. (प्रामाणिक)

• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Virtual'** is **'Authentic'**.

• **Example:** Her silence implied consent.
 
 
 
• **Indirect** (अप्रत्यक्ष): Not directly caused by or resulting from something.
 
 
• **Example:** The statement was an indirect way of criticizing his work.

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd number pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
Out of the given options, 14 : 27 is odd one because in all other options 2nd term is one more than twice the 1st term i.e.

2 : 5 → 2 × 2 + 1 = 4 + 1 = 5.

4 : 9 → 4 × 2 + 1 = 8 + 1 = 9.

12 : 25 → 12 × 2 + 1 = 24 + 1 = 25.

But in 14 : 27 → 14 × 2 + 1 = 28 + 1 = 29 which is not equal to 27.

Thus, 14 : 27 is odd one.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a perfect square?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

N = {a₁}{ⁿ_¹} times {a₂}{ⁿ_²} times {a₃}{ⁿ_³} times ldots times {a_n}{ⁿ_ⁿ}; {a₁,}{a₂},{a₃} are prime numberand {n₁},{n₂},{n₃} are even

Then N is a perfect square. Otherwise not

**Calculation:**

1024 = 2¹⁰

1521 = 3² × 13²

1444 = 2² × 19²

876 = 2² × 3 × 73

All prime factors of all numbers have even power except 876.

**∴ 876 is not a perfect square.**

questions.question: A, B and C together can complete a work in 15 days. B and C can complete the same work in 20 days. In how many days A alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
A, B and C together can complete a work in 15 days

Part of work A,B and C can complete in 1 day = 1/15

B and C can complete the same work in 20 days

Part of work B and C can complete in 1 day = 1/20

∴ Part of work A alone can do in 1 day = 1/15 – 1/20 = 1/60

∴ A alone can do the work in 60 days

questions.question: P, Q and R together can complete a work in 20 days. P alone can complete the work in 40 days, Q alone in 60 days then in how many days R alone can complete the work?
questions.solution:
P, Q and R together can complete a work in 20 days

Part of work P,Q and R can complete in 1 day = 1/20

P can complete the same work in 40 days

Part of work P can complete in 1 day = 1/40

Q can complete the same work in 60 days

Part of work Q can complete in 1 day = 1/60

∴ Part of work R alone can do in 1 day = 1/20 – 1/40 – 1/60 = 1/120

∴ R alone can do the work in 120 days

questions.question: What is the area of a rhombus having one side as 30 cm and one diagonal as 36 cm?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Side of the rhombus = 30 cm

One diagonal = 36 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of Rhombus = (Product of length of two diagonals)/2

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0e7f57e4a7e67f5ea6042fdf32a8b05e9100be897bbd3bda06566bd91afd2f2.png] 

Let,

One side, AB = 30 cm

Diagonal, AC = 36 cm

∵ Diagonals of rhombus bisects each other perpendicularly.

∴ AO = CO = AC/2 = 18 cm

And,

BO = DO = BD/2

From right angled triangle ∆AOB, Using Pythagoras theorem

AB² = AO² + BO²

⇒ 30² = 18² + BO²

⇒ BO² = 900 – 324

⇒ BO² = 576

⇒ BO = 24 cm

∴ BD = 2 × BO = (2 × 24) cm = 48 cm

∴ Area of the rhombus

= (36 × 48)/2

= 36 × 24

= 864 cm²

**∴ The area of the rhombus is 864 cm².**

questions.question: In a college, the ratio of boys and girls is 5 : 3 and the ratio of girls and teachers is 7 : 1. What is the ratio of students and teachers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine the ratios by equalising the common term (Girls) using cross multiplication.

Boys : Girls = 5 : 3 and Girls : Teachers = 7 : 1

Combined Ratio (Boys : Girls : Teachers) = (5 × 7) : (3 × 7) : (3 × 1) = 35 : 21 : 3

Total Students = Boys + Girls = 35 + 21 = 56 parts

Ratio of Students to Teachers = 56 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 56 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Boys to Girls (B : G) = 5 : 3

Ratio of Girls to Teachers (G : T) = 7 : 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f2d6d7b0953c3d51716ff3733b74eb9ecc6610f184135b25ce4d24592da5e95.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ To find the continuous ratio B : G : T, we make the ratio value of Girls equal in both given cases.

⇒ The LCM of 3 and 7 is 21.

⇒ Multiply the first ratio B : G by 7 to get (5 × 7) : (3 × 7) = 35 : 21

⇒ Multiply the second ratio G : T by 3 to get (7 × 3) : (1 × 3) = 21 : 3

⇒ Now the continuous proportion is B : G : T = 35 : 21 : 3

⇒ Total number of students = Boys + Girls

⇒ Total students = 35 + 21 = 56 units

⇒ Number of teachers = 3 units

⇒ Required Ratio = Total Students : Teachers

⇒ Ratio = 56 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 56 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Continuous Proportion

If two ratios a : b and b : c are given, the combined proportion a : b : c can be determined directly by equalising the common term 'b' using the LCM method.

Compound Ratio

When two or more distinct ratios are multiplied with each other, the resulting fraction is called a compound ratio. For a : b and c : d, the compound ratio is ac : bd.

Invertendo Rule

If an equality exists between two ratios such that a : b = c : d, then by the invertendo property, their inverses are also equal: b : a = d : c.

questions.question: A man can row 10 km/hr in still water. If the speed of the current is 2 km/hr, he takes 3 hours more upstream than downstream. What is the distance (in km)?
questions.solution:
Speed of the man in still water = 10 km/h

Speed of the current = 2 km/h

Speed of the man along the current = (10 + 2) km/h = 12 km/h

Speed of the man against the current = (10 – 2) km/h = 8 km/h

Given,

He takes 3 hours more in upstream than in the downstream

Let, The distance is x km = x/8 – x/12 = 3

⇒ x = 72 km

questions.question: What is National Income?

options.text: It is the money value of all goods and services produced in a country in a year
It is the money value of all goods and services produced in a country in two year
It is the money value of all goods and services produced in a country in ﬁve year
It is the money value of all goods and services produced outside the country in a year

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option __**1**__, i.e. __**It is the money value of all goods and services produced in a country in a year.**__

 
• The total money incurred on all the goods and services produced in a given year in a country is termed as the **national income.**
 
• It can also be defined as the Net National Product minus the indirect taxes and subsidies granted by the government.
 
• **NI = NNP at market prices – Indirect taxes – Subsidies**

questions.question: How is the Net National Product calculated?
questions.solution:
• Net National Product is computed by deducting depreciation from the gross national product.

NNP = GNP – Depreciation

 
• Gross national product(GNP) is the net amount of all the goods and services produced in a country in a given year(GDP) along with the income from abroad.

GNP= GDP + Income from Abroad

questions.question: From which date Indian Constitution came into commencement, completely?

questions.question: How many houses are there in the Indian Parliament?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Parliament is the supreme legislative body of India which comprises of the President and houses- the **Rajya Sabha and the Lok Sabha**__.
 
• Rajya Sabha (Council of States) is the upper house of the Parliament and represents the states and union territories.
 
• Lok Sabha (House of the People) is the lower house of the Parliament and represents the people of India as a whole.

questions.question: What is the position of Mercury from the Sun among the eight planets?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e., __**First**__.

 
• Our Solar system consists of eight planets that revolve around the Sun in imaginary orbits and are bounded by gravitational force.
 
• **Mercury **is the smallest and innermost planet in the Solar System.
 
• **Its orbital period around the Sun of 88 days is the shortest of all the planets in the Solar System.**
 
• The order of the planets from first to last moving away from the Sun is Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.

questions.question: What is the zone between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn called?
questions.solution:
__**Explanation:**__

Torrid zone refers to the hottest central belt of the earth bounded by the Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn, characterized by a hot climate. It lies between 23 ½° North latitude and 23 ½° South latitude. It is also known as the hottest zone as it is very close to the equator and sun rays fall directly on it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a192f3577d87c0ea91337f773ba9889b3a1d853552e9aadd0adcfc92554b6699.png] 

__
 
• The zone between the Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn is known as the torrid zone.
 
• There are mainly 3 heat zones on the Earth's surface that arise due to temperature differences. They are -

 
 

 
 
**Zones**__

 
 
 
__**Location**__

 
 
 

 
 
Frigid Zone

 
 
 
Further divided into 2 zones:

 
 
• North frigid zone- between the Arctic Circle 66.5° N and the North Pole 90° N
 
• South frigid zone- between the Antarctic Circle 66.5° S and the South Pole 90° S
 
 
 
 

 
 
Temperate Zone

 
 
 
Further divide into 2 zones:

 
 
• The North temperate zone which is between the Tropic of Cancer 23.5° N and the Arctic Circle 66.5° N
 
• The South temperate zone which is between the Tropic of Capricorn 23.5° S and the Antarctic Circle 66.5° S
 
 
 
 

 
 
Torrid zone

 
 
 
 
• Located between the Tropic of Cancer 23.5° N and the Tropic of Capricorn 23.5° S

questions.question: The reciprocal of resistance is conductance. If the unit of resistance is ohm, the unit of conductance will be ________.
questions.solution:
• Obstruction to the flow of current is called electrical resistance. Its SI unit is ohm(Ω).
 
• Electrical conductance(G) is defined as the ease with which electric current can pass through a conductor.
 
• It is the reciprocal of resistance, therefore, its SI unit is ohm⁻¹ commonly referred as mho.

questions.question: Minimum energy is required when a body is ________.

options.text: pulled on a plane horizontal surface

questions.solution:
__**CONCEPT**:__

__
 
• **Friction force**: When two objects are in contact and one object **moves or intends to move** then an **opposing force** develops between the two surfaces called** frictional force**. The friction force is usually denoted by **“f”**.
 
• Due to **friction force, there is a loss in energy**.
 
• **Energy**: The capacity to do work is called energy.

**EXPLANATION**:__

 
• On a** smooth surface, there is no friction**,** so the loss of energy is zero **on the smooth surface.
 
• **Minimum energy is required when a body is pushed over smooth rollers**. So option 3 is correct.
 
• The more the force applied, the more is the work done.
 
• Since **rolling friction provides the least amount of opposing force**,** less work has to be done hence less energy**.

questions.question: What is the ﬁrst page of a website called?

questions.question: When sodium reacts with ﬂuorine, ________.

options.text: each ﬂuorine atom loses one electron
each sodium atom gains one electron
fluorine neither gains nor loses an electron
the compound formed is a good conductor of electricity in the molten state

questions.solution:

• The presence of ions makes sodium flouride a good conductor of electricity in the molten state.
 
• Sodium flouride finds its applicatons in metallurgy and is also used as a cleansing agent.

questions.question: Essential component of an amalgam is ________.
questions.solution:

• The alloys are bonded by metallic bonding and depending upon the proportion of mercury present in the alloy, the physical state may be liquid, soft paste or solid.

questions.question: What is the effect of greenhouse gases on the average temperature of the earth’s atmosphere?
questions.solution:
• The greenhouse effect occurs when Earth's atmosphere traps solar radiation because of the presence of certain gases called green house gases.
 
• This results in an overall increase in the average temperature of the earth’s atmosphere.
 
• Some major greenhouse gases are- Carbon dioxide, Methane, Nitrous oxide, Chlorofluorocarbons, etc.

questions.question: Which is a scheme for providing Physical aids and Assisted-living Devices for senior citizens belonging to BPL category?
questions.solution:
• Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana is a scheme that was launched to aid senior citizens belonging to the BPL category by providing them with Physical aids and Assisted-living Devices like spectacles, wheelchairs, dentures,etc.
 
• The scheme was launched by the Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment on 1st April 2017.
 
• The responsibility of providing these aides and their maintenance is given to Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation (ALIMCO), a PSU.

questions.question: Who invented Barometer?
questions.solution:
• An instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure, the barometer was invented by Evangelista Torricelli in 1643.
 
• E. Torricelli was an Italian mathematician and physicist and was a student of Galileo Galilei.

questions.question: Which country will host the 2019 ICC Cricket World Cup?
questions.solution:
• The 12th edition of the ICC Cricket World Cup will be hosted by England and Wales.
 
• It is scheduled from 30th May 2019 to 14th July 2019.

questions.question: Which art is also known as Greco-Buddhist art?
questions.solution:
• Gandhara Art also popularly known as the Greco-Buddhist art was a mixture of Greek and Buddhist culture.
 
• It flourished under the Kushan empire, present-day northwestern Pakistan and parts of Afghanistan, between 1st century BCE to 5thcentury BCE.

questions.question: Who was/were the last person/persons to be awarded ‘Bharat Ratna’? (for year 2015)

options.text: Both Madan Mohan Malaviya and Atal Bihari Vajpayee

questions.solution:
__
 
• Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya and former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee were the last recipients of the Bharat Ratna.
 
• They were awarded Bharat Ratna in 2015.
 
• Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award in India.
 
• **2019 awardees are Pranab Mukherjee, Nanaji Deshmukh, Bhupen Hazarika.**__

questions.question: Who is the author of book named "A Bend in the River"?
questions.solution:
• V.S Naipaul is the author of the book named "A Bend in the River”.
 
• The book was published in May, 1979 and was also short-listed for the Booker Prize in 1979.
 
• Its story is narrated by an Indian-Muslim shopkeeper, Salim, who observes changes in Africa.

questions.question: The African Nuclear Weapon Free Zone treaty is also called as ________.
questions.solution:
• Signed in 1996, the African Nuclear-Weapon-Free Zone treaty is also known as the Pelindaba Treaty.
 
• It came into effect on 15th July 2009.
 
• According to this treaty, the research, development, stockpiling, possession, manufacture, control or stationing of nuclear explosive devices is prohibited in the territory of all parties involved in the treaty.
 
• It also prohibits dumping of radioactive waste in the African zone.

questions.question: Which neighbouring country of India is also known by the name of Burma?
questions.solution:
• Burma also known as Myanmar is a Southeast Asian country located to the east of India.
 
• It is also flanked by Bangladesh to the west, China to the north and Thailand to the east.
 
• In 1989, the name of Burma was officially changed to Myanmar by the military government.
